avatar-characters.prompt: Name a character from Avatar: The Last Airbender or The Legend of Korra.
avatar-characters.scope: Named or distinctly identified characters from the Avatar: The Last Airbender/Legend of Korra world, including its comics and novels, count. Animals and named spirits count. James Cameron's unrelated Avatar films, voice actors, nations and generic bending abilities do not count.

government-space-agencies.prompt: Name a government space agency or international space-research organization.
government-space-agencies.scope: Real national, governmental and international organizations whose main work includes space research, space exploration or coordinating space activities count, including historical agencies. A commercial rocket company, a location alone or an individual is not automatically an agency.
